items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: No. He -- not that I know of. But he was at this party all night.

ctx.x: We played for a party at the Prince of Wales -- for the Prince of Wales. Oh many parties. Played Lord Beaverbrook's house and places like that.
Barry Ulanov says (Inaudible) the Prince of Wales sat in with the band once.
No. He -- not that I know of. But he was at this party all night. And you know you don't leave until the prince leaves. And so they had a very nice time and that's all I remember, I think.
